cards.text: The crowd is still cheering after the final whistle. The team could run a victory lap, but the bus leaves in ten minutes.

choices.label: Take a victory lap
choices.result: The fans love it, but the players board the bus tired and a little late.

choices.label: Head straight to the bus
choices.result: The team rests well, and a few fans go home feeling ignored.

cards.text: {name} ran for a lot of yards today and the leg is sore. The next game is only a few days away.

choices.label: Train through it
choices.result: {name} keeps sharp in practice, but the sore leg gets no rest and the mood drops.

choices.label: Rest for a week
choices.result: {name} heals up and feels looked after, but practice is quieter this week.

cards.text: The owner invites the whole squad to a victory dinner tonight. Film study was planned for the same evening.

choices.label: Go to the dinner
choices.result: The squad enjoys a big meal and the owner is delighted, but no film gets watched.

choices.label: Stay for film study
choices.result: The coaches get a lot out of the film, but the owner is hurt that the invitation was turned down.

cards.text: {name} kicked the winning goal, and the bakery in town wants a photo with {name}. {name} is shy about being in the paper.

choices.label: Do the photo
choices.result: The picture goes up in the shop window and fans smile, though {name} feels awkward.

choices.label: Skip the photo
choices.result: {name} is relieved and relaxed, but the shop owner and some fans are disappointed.

cards.text: {name} threw two bad passes and is sitting alone in the locker room. The rest of the team is waiting to review the game.

choices.label: Talk to them privately
choices.result: {name} opens up and feels much better, but the team review is put off.

choices.label: Hold a team meeting
choices.result: The team studies the mistakes together, but {name} feels put on the spot.

cards.text: Some fans booed as the team walked off the field. A reporter asks what {club} has to say to them.

choices.label: Apologise to the fans
choices.result: Fans appreciate the honesty, but the owner thinks the club sounded weak.

choices.label: Defend the team
choices.result: The players feel backed up, but the fans are not happy to be brushed off.

cards.text: {name} missed a block that led to a big play, and the other linemen are grumbling about it.

choices.label: Run extra blocking drills
choices.result: The line works hard and learns a lot, but everyone is tired and grumpy.

choices.label: Let it go this time
choices.result: The line calms down and moves on, but nothing new is learned.

cards.text: The defence gave up points late, and {name} says the coaches chose the wrong plan. Other players heard it.

choices.label: Back the coaches
choices.result: The coaches are glad you stood by them, but {name} feels ignored.

choices.label: Hear them out
choices.result: {name} feels respected and the coaches take notes, but the owner is not pleased about open disagreement.

cards.text: There is no game this week. The squad can go on a day trip to the lake, or spend the time practising extra.

choices.label: Go on a day trip
choices.result: The players laugh and bond, but the trip costs money and the owner notices.

choices.label: Practise extra
choices.result: The coaches get a lot of practice time in, but the players start to feel worn out.

cards.text: The town is opening a new playground and asks {name} to cut the ribbon on the free day. {name} wanted to sleep in.

choices.label: Go to the opening
choices.result: Children cheer and parents take pictures, but {name} is tired all day.

choices.label: Stay home and rest
choices.result: {name} feels fresh and happy, but the town is let down.

cards.text: {name} wants to visit family during the bye week and would miss one practice.

choices.label: Let them go
choices.result: {name} comes back happy and ready, but a practice is missed.

choices.label: Ask them to stay
choices.result: The practice goes ahead with everyone there, but {name} is upset.

cards.text: A local school asks {name} to help with a reading class this week. It would take time away from studying game film.

choices.label: Go to the school
choices.result: The children adore {name} and the club looks kind, but no film gets studied.

choices.label: Study the film
choices.result: {name} learns the other team inside out, but the school and a few fans are disappointed.

cards.text: Heavy rain is coming for tonight's game, and the grounds crew says the field will be slow and slippery.

choices.label: Practise in the mud
choices.result: The team learns to cope with the wet field, but everyone gets cold and cranky.

choices.label: Stay dry and rest
choices.result: The players stay warm and calm, but they have no practice in the mud.

cards.text: {name} wants to wear a bright new pair of boots in the game. Nobody has tried them on the field yet.

choices.label: Allow the new boots
choices.result: {name} feels great and the fans love the colour, but the boots are a gamble.

choices.label: Stick to the old boots
choices.result: The old boots are a safe choice and the coaches are happy, but {name} is let down.

cards.text: {name} asks to practise kicks in the empty stadium before the gates open. The grounds crew is still working on the field.

choices.label: Allow the practice
choices.result: {name} gets good kicking practice, but the grounds crew is slowed down and the owner hears about it.

choices.label: Ask them to wait
choices.result: The grounds crew finishes on time and the owner is happy, but {name} feels rushed and nervous.

cards.text: A fan club leader asks {name} to wave to the crowd during warm-ups. It would be loud and distracting.

choices.label: Wave to the crowd
choices.result: The crowd roars and the stadium feels alive, but {name} is a bit rattled.

choices.label: Stay focused
choices.result: {name} stays calm and sharp, but some fans think the team is cold.
